objective: Create a reusable scene-level exclusion asset that removes every verified Haze4K source relationship from RESIDE ITS before evaluating the frozen Haze4K ConvIR-B checkpoint in the synthetic-indoor target domain.

its_haze4k_source_exclusion.core_assumption: A frozen full-census multi-view and geometric source matcher can recover all provenance-expected indoor Haze4K source relationships in ITS and conservatively exclude every accepted near-duplicate family.
its_haze4k_source_exclusion.close_condition: Close after the single frozen full-census identity audit; failure to recover every expected relationship establishes only a method-specific failure and does not certify absence of overlap.
